scope: common-tail child traversal only; parent candidate scan and all rewrite/equality/ownership gates unchanged

quality.sidecars: full byte identity except manifest invocation/tool identity
quality.reference_algorithm: all recursive blocks use the previous full rescan; 1200 fixed-seed trees across three tail contexts and two modes

performance.workload: full private corpus, warm filesystem CLI
performance.target: reduce redundant recursive traversal with deterministic counters; do not claim a wall-time speedup unless measured beyond noise

fallback: If quality differs, investigate/refuse the change. If complete measurements exceed the frozen cost limits, retain the baseline by default and record an isolated experiment instead.
